Fit logistic regression models using predictors of interest. Restricted cubic splines are applied where appropriate to allow for non-linear effects.

### Logistic model 1 (LM1)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

                  data = df_predictors, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
plan <- gsheet2tbl("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cNITyyiNkLdamBfp9AqNm8X7eY88kEtRcp4yIgQJzg0/edit?usp=sharing") |> 
  # Convert dates and ensure study is a factor
  mutate(start_date = as.Date(start_date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         end_date = as.Date(end_date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) 

weather <- plan |>  
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    weather = list(get_power(
  community = "AG",
  pars = c("T2M_MIN", "RH2M", "PRECTOTCORR", "T2MDEW"),
  temporal_api = "DAILY",
  lonlat = c(longitude, latitude), # lon, lat
  dates = c(start_date, end_date)
))) %>%
  unnest(weather) |> 
  mutate(days = as.numeric(YYYYMMDD - start_date))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- 1. Criar blocos de 6 dias ---
blocks <- map(0:(29-6+1), ~ .x:(.x+5))

# --- 2. Função para processar cada bloco ---
process_block <- function(data, block_days) {
  data %>%
    filter(days %in% block_days) %>%
    group_by(study) %>%
    summarise(
      tmin = mean(T2M_MIN, na.rm = TRUE),
      dew  = mean(T2MDEW, na.rm = TRUE),
      rh   = mean(RH2M, na.rm = TRUE),
      prec = sum(PRECTOTCORR, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(block_start = min(block_days),
           block_end   = max(block_days))
}

# --- 3. Aplicar para todos os blocos e adicionar ID de ambiente ---
df_local <- map_dfr(blocks, ~ process_block(weather, .x)) %>%
  arrange(study, block_start) %>%
  mutate(environment_id = row_number())

# --- 4. Calcular probabilidade prevista pelo modelo treinado ---
df_local$pred_risk <- predict(m_logistic, newdata = df_local, type = "fitted")

# --- 5. Visualizar resultados ---
ggplot(df_local, aes(x = block_start, y = pred_risk, color = study)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~study)+
  labs(x = "Início do bloco de 6 dias",
       y = "Probabilidade prevista de giberela",
       title = "Risco previsto pelo modelo para Santa Rosa e Passo Fundo") +
  theme_minimal()+
    ylim(0,1)       # força o eixo y de 0 a 1
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Function to summarize weather variables over a range of days
process_weather_var <- function(data, var_name, days_range, new_col_name, summary_func = c("mean", "sum")) {
  summary_func <- match.arg(summary_func)
  day_cols <- as.character(days_range)
  
  # Choose the function dynamically
  summarise_fn <- switch(summary_func,
                         mean = rowMeans,
                         sum = function(x, na.rm = TRUE) rowSums(x, na.rm = na.rm))
  
  data %>%
    mutate(!!sym(var_name) := as.numeric(!!sym(var_name))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var_name))) %>%
    
    group_by(study, days) %>%
    summarise(!!sym(var_name) := mean(!!sym(var_name), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    
    pivot_wider(names_from = days, values_from = !!sym(var_name)) %>%
    
    mutate(!!sym(new_col_name) := summarise_fn(
      dplyr::select(., any_of(day_cols)), na.rm = TRUE
    )) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(study, !!sym(new_col_name)) |> 
    mutate(study = as.factor(study))
}


process_weather_var <- function(data, var_name, days_range, new_col_name,
                                summary_func = c("mean", "sum", "count_above"),
                                threshold = NULL) {
  summary_func <- match.arg(summary_func)
  day_cols <- as.character(days_range)

  # Dynamic function based on summary_func
  summarise_fn <- switch(summary_func,
    mean = function(x) rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum = function(x) rowSums(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_above = {
      if (is.null(threshold)) stop("You must specify a threshold for count_above")
      function(x) rowSums(x > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  )

  data %>%
    mutate(!!sym(var_name) := as.numeric(!!sym(var_name))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var_name))) %>%
    
    group_by(study, days) %>%
    summarise(!!sym(var_name) := mean(!!sym(var_name), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    
    pivot_wider(names_from = days, values_from = !!sym(var_name)) %>%
    
    mutate(!!sym(new_col_name) := summarise_fn(
      dplyr::select(., any_of(day_cols))
    )) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(study, !!sym(new_col_name)) %>%
    mutate(study = as.factor(study))
}


# Process each variable with explicit package references
T2M_MIN_pred <- process_weather_var(weather, "T2M_MIN", 2:10, "tmin")
T2MDEW_pred <- process_weather_var(weather, "T2MDEW", 4:10, "dew")
RH2M_pred <- process_weather_var(weather, "RH2M", 5:10, "rh")
PRECTOTCORR_pred2 <- process_weather_var(weather, "PRECTOTCORR", 6:10, "prec2", summary_func = "sum")

# Combine with epidemic status
epidemic <- plan %>%
  dplyr::distinct(study, epidemic) %>%
  mutate(study = factor(study))

# Combine all data
df_local <- epidemic %>%
  dplyr::left_join(T2M_MIN_pred, by = "study") |> 
  dplyr::left_join(RH2M_pred, by = "study") |>  
  dplyr::left_join(PRECTOTCORR_pred2, by = "study") |> 
  dplyr::left_join(T2MDEW_pred, by = "study")
```
